title: Crunchy Oatcrisp Bites
description: A simple and crunchy snack made with oatcrisp and crunch. Perfect for munching on the go.
instructions: In a large bowl, mix oatcrisp and crunch.
In a separate bowl, mix honey, melted butter, and salt.
Pour the wet ingredients over the dry ingredients and stir until combined.
Gradually add water and stir until the mixture forms a dough.
Roll out the dough to 1/4 inch thickness.
Cut into desired shapes (e.g., squares, circles, etc.).
Place on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake for 15-20 minutes or until lightly browned.
Allow to cool completely before serving.
